subject: Medford Community Day and School Athletics
overview: Student reporters provided coverage of Medford's Community Day and interviewed various coaches and student-athletes regarding the start of the fall sports season.

items.title: Introduction and Opening Remarks
items.summary: Victoria Rasche and Principal John Perella introduced the inaugural edition of the Mustang Report.

items.title: Community Day Festivities
items.summary: The program featured a performance of the national anthem and a series of interviews with participants at Medford's Community Day.

items.title: Student Group and Athletics Interviews
items.summary: Reporters spoke with representatives from the cheerleading team, Boy Scout Troop 416, and the girls hockey program about their upcoming activities.

items.title: Public Safety and Community Outreach
items.summary: Captain McCourt demonstrated a fire safety trailer while police representatives discussed the role of the motorcycle unit in the community.

items.title: MHS Alumni Association
items.summary: Allison Goldsberry and Dan Costello promoted the Alumni Association's scholarship fundraising efforts and the upcoming Medford Night event.

items.title: Fall Sports Outlook
items.summary: Athletes and coaches from the soccer, volleyball, and football programs discussed their training regimens and early-season performance.

items.title: DreamFar Running Program
items.summary: Wendy Horne described the DreamFar program, which prepares students and teachers for a 26.2-mile marathon through a seven-month training cycle.

items.title: Senior Class Updates
items.summary: Student anchors announced the schedule for senior superlatives and car portraits taking place in late September.

items.title: Event Highlights
items.summary: The report concluded with footage from a cross-country race against Arlington Catholic and highlights from the senior outing at Kimball Farm.
